description: Turn a platform idea into brief, capability map, options and a slice roadmap.

cases.prompt: I want to build an enterprise work-management platform with ERP and mobile. Where do we start?

assertions: Runs project-discovery first and does not assume greenfield.
Defines users, jobs-to-be-done, workflows, constraints and success metrics, separating primitives from modules.
Picks one end-to-end vertical slice that tests the riskiest assumption and records MVP non-goals.

cases.prompt: Plan the platform; we have no access to the legacy ERP API yet.

assertions: Records the missing ERP access as a blocker with options rather than papering over it.

cases.prompt: Add a filter to the existing task list.

assertions: Routes to change-intake and normal discovery; no platform discovery for a small change.
